login.errorRateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

login.serverUnreachable: Could not reach the server. You can still try to sign in.

accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Create the first one below.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.archiveConfirm: Archive this account? It leaves the list but its history is kept, and you can unarchive it later.
accounts.checkpointHelp: The amount is the balance at the end of the chosen day.

categories.label: Category

errors.network: Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid: The data was not accepted. Review it and try again.
errors.not_found: Item not found. Reload the page.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.rate_limit: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
errors.invalid_name: Enter a name with 1 to 80 characters.
errors.invalid_description: The description must be 1 to 300 characters long.
errors.not_ofx: Choose an .ofx file exported by the bank.
errors.too_large: The file is larger than 5 MB. Export a shorter period.
errors.malformed: The file could not be read: its OFX content is malformed.
errors.forbidden_dtd: The file contains a forbidden declaration (DTD/entity) and was rejected for safety.
errors.unsupported_multiple_statements: The file contains more than one statement. Export one statement per file.
errors.account_type_mismatch: The file type does not match the chosen account: an account statement goes to a checking account, a card bill goes to a credit card account.
errors.already_imported: This file was already imported. Undo the previous import if you want to import it again.
errors.account_archived: The chosen account is archived. Unarchive it or choose another account.
errors.unsupported_amount_precision: The file has amounts with more than 2 decimal places and cannot be imported.
errors.unsupported_line: The file has a line outside the accepted limits and cannot be imported.
errors.invalid_override: The chosen classification was not accepted (invalid line or category). Review and try again.
errors.preview_expired: The preview expired or no longer exists. Upload the file again.
errors.blocking_warnings: Some warnings need your confirmation. Read the Warnings tab and tick the box to confirm.
errors.unsupported_file: Unsupported file type. Upload an .ofx or .xlsx file.
errors.unsupported_bank: Could not identify a supported bank in this file. Nubank (.ofx) and Itaú (.ofx and .xlsx card bill) are supported.
errors.not_xlsx: The file is not a valid .xlsx spreadsheet.
errors.encrypted_xlsx: The spreadsheet is password-protected and cannot be read. Export an unprotected copy.
errors.xlsx_limits_exceeded: The spreadsheet exceeds the accepted size limits and cannot be imported.
errors.xlsx_unsafe_content: The spreadsheet contains forbidden content and was rejected for safety.
errors.unsupported_layout: This spreadsheet layout is not recognized. Use the original Itaú .xlsx card bill, unedited.
errors.invalid_cell: The spreadsheet has a cell with an invalid value and cannot be imported.
errors.one_file: Upload one file at a time.
errors.invalid_account: Choose an active checking or credit card account.

import.help: Upload the statement or card bill (.ofx from Nubank or Itaú; Itaú card bill as .xlsx), one file at a time, up to 5 MB. Nothing is recorded until you confirm.
import.accountHint: Account statement → checking account; card bill → credit card account.
import.noAccounts: No active checking or credit card account. Create one on the Accounts screen.

fileHint.none: Choose the account to see which file to upload.
fileHint.Checking: Checking account: upload the .ofx statement (Nubank or Itaú).
fileHint.CreditCard: Credit card: upload the .ofx bill (Nubank) or .xlsx bill (Itaú).

import.noPeriod: Period not given in the file
import.expires: This preview expires at {when} (24 h after upload). After that, upload the file again.
import.pendingHelp: These transactions will stay pending classification and out of the monthly summary until they are classified. You can classify them now or later, on the Pending screen.
import.existingHelp: They already exist in this account and will not be changed.
import.ack: I understand the warnings and want to confirm
import.blockedHelp: This import cannot be confirmed: undo the previous import of this bill and import again.
import.alreadyImportedHelp: File already imported: nothing will be created. The lines below are for information only; cancel this preview.

notices.not_preview: This preview was no longer open (it was already confirmed or undone), so nothing was undone. See the history below; to undo a confirmed import, use its Undo button.

warnings.AlreadyImported: This file was already imported; nothing new will be added.
warnings.AccountIdentifierMismatch: The account identifier in the file differs from the chosen account's.
warnings.FitidInOtherAccount: Some lines of this file already exist in another account.
warnings.DateOutsidePeriod: Some lines are dated outside the file's period.
warnings.BalanceMismatch: The file balance does not match the last recorded balance plus the transactions after it.
warnings.PeriodGap: There is a gap between this file and the periods already imported for this account.
warnings.PeriodOverlap: This file's period overlaps periods already imported for this account.
warnings.InvoiceTotalMismatch: The sum of the bill lines does not match the bill total declared in the file.
warnings.InvoiceHasMissingLines: This bill is missing lines that were imported before; the import cannot proceed. Undo the previous import of this bill and import again with the complete file.
warnings.LedgerBalanceBeforeLastLine: The balance reported in the file predates the last line and will not be used as a balance checkpoint.
warnings.PossibleDuplicate: Some lines look like duplicates of existing transactions.
warnings.UnknownLineKinds: The file has unknown line kinds, treated as ordinary transactions.
warnings.UnknownCardSuffix: Some lines have card last digits not yet seen on this account.

history.title: Import history
history.undoBody: Every transaction created by this import and the balance it recorded will be removed, including the ones you edited or deleted.
history.edited: Transactions you edited that will also be removed: {n}.
history.editedFailed: Could not check how many transactions you edited. Try again before undoing.
history.crossBatch: Note: lines that another batch skipped because they already existed will also be removed, since this import created them.
history.deletedKeys: Lines you deleted that belong to other imports keep occupying their key and do not come back when you re-import; lines deleted from this import come back if you import the file again.

pending.help: Transactions waiting to be classified. Adjust the state and category right on the row.

transactions.amountHint: Type the amount without a sign and pick Expense or Income (or type - for an expense). E.g. 1234.56.
transactions.cardHint: On a credit card, a purchase is a negative amount (expense).
transactions.deleteImported: This transaction came from an import. It will be hidden and will not come back if the same file is imported again.
transactions.deleteManual: This transaction will be permanently removed.

overview.pendingOutside: {count} pending outside the summary | {count} pending outside the summary
overview.sixMonthAlt: Bar chart of income and expenses for the last six months
overview.categoriesAlt: Doughnut chart of expenses by category; the list beside it has the same data
overview.emptyBody: Import a statement or card bill to see the summary, charts and latest transactions.
